reviews.title: Quick install and great performance
reviews.comment:
I tried a 3 fan 360mm AIO in the front of my full tower with a 5070ti but the hoses were too short.  So I went with this 2 fan 240mm top-mounted, and it works most excellently so far.
Super easy 8 screws radiator install. 4 screws for the AM5 adaptor bracket.  (Need a flathead screwdriver for those.)
Nice size USB attached LCD display.
This thing dropped my Ryzen 9 9950X max temp from aircooler 95.1 degrees C to a watercooled 76 degrees C during the Passmark CPU test.  Idle temp went from 45 to 35!
The Display software is not super intuitive, but you can modify the layout and what you want to display. Can load pics and video clips, too.
The included thermal paste is peanut butter thick but effective.  I spread it thin with my finger and plastic wrap.  (This was the hardest part of the installation.)  Pretty quiet so far.
Great value. Hope the pump lasts!
reviews.author: Christopher R., Texas Aggie Engineer

reviews.title: good product
reviews.comment: considering this was close to the cheapest AIO I could find that matched my white them, I am pleased. It looks great, works as it should, and cools the cpu very well. Install was easy and it is very quiet. For the money good bang for your buck
reviews.author: Alec

reviews.title: Buy it!
reviews.comment: Damn good AIO. It keeps my Ryzen 7 5800xt at 65c at 100% load. 35-40c idle. Does the job. Im very happy with it.
reviews.author: Ray

reviews.title: Great value and works well
reviews.comment: AIO with RGB and programmable lcd screen at this price is crazy good deal. Longevity remains to be seen but at this price you can buy 2 of these cheaper than a competitors AIO with the same goodies.
reviews.author: Brad Flicker

reviews.title: It's good
reviews.comment: So, This cooler has been in my computer for a little over 3 months. I does it's job well. The information screen is fun, but the lettering is far to small for me to read, so it does what it is made for, but the info screen is redundant. Still, I am happy, and would recommend this CPU cooler.
